purpose: Document separate English/local-language searches, first-party local registry/cadastre evidence, and bounded anonymous geometry discovery.
assessment: The legacy provincial iLand portal is an official land-information map shell but requires login. After administrative restructuring, Ho Chi Minh City offers a general land-information portal and planning GIS; neither reviewed route exposes anonymous full parcel polygons. The precise administrative custody of the legacy portal after restructuring remains uncertain.
registryAssessment: First-party registry, cadastral or land-administration custodian route identified as described in the cited official-source observations; public safe geometry remains unverified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Former Ba Ria–Vung Tau land-information portal exposes an iLand map shell but presents login controls; no anonymous parcel feature was inspected.
Current Ho Chi Minh City land-information portal provides a QR certificate lookup/login route; no public parcel vector layer is documented.
Official HCMGIS interactive map shows city thematic layers but not a cadastral parcel layer in its visible catalog.
Official 2026 Ho Chi Minh City planning GIS is described as a planning/urban data portal, inheriting legacy Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu data; not a cadastral parcel geometry route.
